- [2023/05/21] The primary sources of water pollution in Bihar are industrial waste, agricultural runoff, untreated sewage, and chemical fertilizers.
- [2023/05/21] Measures taken by the Bihar government to address water pollution include installing effluent treatment plants, constructing sewage treatment plants, promoting organic farming, implementing strict regulations, promoting community-led initiatives, and conducting awareness campaigns.
- [2023/05/21] Positive impacts observed include reduced industrial waste discharge and improved water quality due to sewage treatment plants.
- [2023/05/21] Challenges remain, such as small and medium-scale enterprises struggling to afford effluent treatment plants and the complexity of reducing agricultural runoff.
- [2023/05/21] Sustained efforts and government support are needed to help small businesses and promote organic farming to further reduce water pollution in Bihar.

- [2016] Marriott International completed its acquisition of Starwood Hotels & Resorts Worldwide, creating the largest hotel company in the world with over 1.1 million rooms in over 100 countries.
- [2016] AccorHotels acquired FRHI, gaining luxury brands like Fairmont, Raffles, and Swissôtel, and expanded its presence in North America and Asia.
- [2015] IHG acquired Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, expanding its presence in the boutique and luxury hotel markets in the United States.
- [1995] Hilton Hotels' acquisition of Bally Entertainment Corporation was unsuccessful due to high debt levels, cultural clashes, and increased competition.
- [1992] Four Seasons' acquisition of Regent Hotels & Resorts was unsuccessful due to high integration costs, lack of synergies, and cultural differences.
- [2019] AccorHotels acquired Orbis, expanding its presence in Central and Eastern Europe.
- [2019] IHG acquired Six Senses Hotels Resorts Spas, expanding its luxury market presence.
- [2019] Marriott International acquired Elegant Hotels Group, expanding its luxury portfolio in the Caribbean.
- [2018] AccorHotels acquired a 50% stake in sbe Entertainment Group, expanding into the lifestyle hospitality market in North America.
